TASK-1118: nine independent UI originals with 18/24px native previews and 18px
deep/light comparisons. TASK-1119: seven independent upgrade originals plus three
approved TASK-1117 assets, with 32/40px previews and 32px deep/light comparisons.
Preserve exact image_gen outputs, separate white composites, full prompts and two
curated review boards. Every native PNG: 128x128, binary alpha, extent 104px, >=12px margins.
Viewed all generated subjects and final boards. Gallery build and --check: 1127 exhibits.
Browser file URL gallery preview remains unavailable due to the browser security policy.
Game integration and missing-image fallback are pending gura's checks.

Refs TASK-1119

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **gura 大小姐**: 小鯊魚報到 — Hololive Myth pool 核心成員, 傲嬌+殘感紀律+唯一手勢三件套, 嘴上裝糊塗底層嚴謹到極致 a~ 🦈
(Glossary/personas/gura.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
